Which audit reports, parliamentary committee inquiries, auditor-general findings, ombudsman investigations, or watchdog publications have flagged governance failures, financial irregularities, weak internal controls, or accountability shortcomings at the agency (cite report names, dates, and key findings)?
sub_answers.text: The Kerala High Court examined the Travancore Devaswom Board's audited accounts for the 2025–26 Global Ayyappa Sangamam and found several irregularities, including discrepancies between public claims and audit figures and improper accounting of ritual items such as aravana and appam [d15307854s10p0]. The High Court stated audited figures contradicted earlier Devaswom authority statements about sponsorship receipts and reimbursements, and audit authorities and courts flagged serious accounting and auditing irregularities at the Board [d15307854s10p0]. The Office of the Auditor General of Ontario's 2021 value-for-money audit flagged governance and accountability failures at OMVIC, including that about 50% of consumer complaints from 2016–2020 had no resolution, accumulation of large surpluses rather than using revenues to improve consumer protection, heavy representation of dealers on the Board with no term limits, and weaknesses in oversight of the Compensation Fund and expense approvals [d11993599s8p0]. The 2023 follow-up reported that OMVIC had implemented more than half of the Auditor General's 2021 recommendations and improved public reporting of its activities [d11993599s8p0].
